title: Targeting interactions between the Galectin-3 intrinsically disordered and structured domains based on long time-scale accelerated molecular dynamics
authors: Bhattacharya S; Zhang M; Hu W; Qi T; Heisterkamp N
one_liner_zh: 该文结合加速分子动力学模拟与NMR，预测Galectin-3无序N端与结构化C端结构域的互作界面并设计抑制肽，直接聚焦IDR介导的PPI机制建模，方法可迁移至其他无序蛋白互作靶点。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) are common and important functional domains in many proteins. However, IDRs are difficult to target for drug development due to the lack of defined structures which would facilitate the identification of possible drug-binding pockets. Galectin-3 is a carbohydrate-binding protein of which overexpression has been implicated in a wide variety of disorders including cancer and inflammation. Apart from its carbohydrate recognition/binding domain (CRD), Galectin-3 also contains a functionally important disordered N-terminal domain (NTD) that contacts the C-terminal domain (CTD) and could be a target for drug development. To overcome challenges involved in inhibitor design due to lack of structure and the highly dynamic nature of the NTD, we used a novel protocol combining nuclear magnetic resonance data from recombinant Galectin-3 with accelerated molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. This approach identified a pocket in the CTD with which the NTD makes frequent contact. In accordance with this model, mutation of residues L131 and L203 in this pocket caused loss of Galectin-3 agglutination ability, signifying the functional relevance of the cavity. In - silico screening was used to design candidate inhibitory peptides targeting the newly discovered cavity and experimental testing of only 3 of these yielded one peptide that inhibits the agglutination promoted by wild type Galectin-3. NMR experiments further confirmed that this peptide indeed binds to a cavity in the CTD not within the actual CRD. Our results show that it is possible to apply a combination of MD simulations and NMR experiments to precisely predict the binding interface of a disordered domain with a structured domain, and furthermore use this predicted interface for designing inhibitors. This procedure can be potentially extended to many other targets in which similar IDR interactions play a vital functional role.
abstract_zh: 固有无序区域（IDRs）是许多蛋白质中常见且重要的功能结构域。然而，由于缺乏有助于识别潜在药物结合口袋的明确结构，IDRs难以成为药物开发的靶点。Galectin-3是一种碳水化合物结合蛋白，其过表达与多种疾病（包括癌症和炎症）相关。除了其碳水化合物识别/结合域（CRD）外，Galectin-3还包含一个功能重要的无序N端结构域（NTD），该结构域与C端结构域（CTD）接触，并可能成为药物开发的靶点。为了克服因缺乏结构及NTD高度动态特性而导致的抑制剂设计挑战，我们采用了一种新方案，该方案结合了重组Galectin-3的核磁共振数据与加速分子动力学（MD）模拟。这种方法在CTD中识别出一个NTD频繁接触的口袋。与该模型一致，此口袋中残基L131和L203的突变导致Galectin-3凝集能力丧失，表明该空腔的功能相关性。通过计算机模拟筛选设计靶向新发现空腔的候选抑制肽，仅对其中3种进行实验测试，便得到一种能抑制野生型Galectin-3促进凝集的肽。核磁共振实验进一步证实，该肽确实结合于CTD中的一个空腔，而非实际CRD内。我们的结果表明，结合MD模拟和核磁共振实验可以精确预测无序结构域与有序结构域之间的结合界面，并进一步利用该预测界面设计抑制剂。此方法可潜在地扩展到许多其他类似IDR相互作用发挥关键功能作用的靶点。
